yt_title: Fork And Spoon Balance On A Glass: Why Does It Work? #Shorts
desc: A fork and spoon balance on a toothpick because their centre of mass sits below the tip. Hook them together, wedge a toothpick and rest it on a glass rim. New fizzy fact every day on Fruit Soda.
caption: Try it and tell us if it works! 🍴 Ask an adult first and be careful with the toothpick. Follow for a fact every day. Save this. Comment WORKS or FALLS.

lines.text: A fork and spoon balance on a single toothpick.
Hook the fork and spoon together, with the handles apart.
Wedge a toothpick between them, then rest its tip on a glass rim.
Their weight hangs below that tiny pivot, so any wobble swings back.
The centre of mass sits below the tip. That is why it never falls.
